name: MySQL
description: Trigger workflows from new or updated rows in a MySQL or MariaDB database, and query or write to it from a step.

triggers.label: New rows in a table
triggers.description: Fires once per row inserted after the last seen value of the ordering column.

env.name: MYSQL_URL
env.description: mysql://user:password@host:3306/database. Your provider shows it on the database page; otherwise ask your DBA. The user needs SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE on the tables the workflow touches, as the steps demand.
env.builderHint: Percent-encode @ / : ? # and % in the password. The port defaults to 3306; the database after the slash is the default schema. An ssl-mode=… attribute is honoured when the ssl setting is blank.

env.name: MYSQL_SSL
env.description: One of disabled, required, verify-full. Default disabled. "required" encrypts without checking the certificate, which the driver strongly discourages; "verify-full" checks the chain and host name.
env.builderHint: Cloud providers usually want verify-full with their CA bundle in sslCa, or required when the bundle is unavailable.

env.name: MYSQL_SSL_CA
env.description: Path to a PEM CA bundle for verify-full against a private CA. Blank uses Node's roots.

env.name: MYSQL_TABLE
env.description: For both triggers: table or db.table to watch.
env.builderHint: Used by the triggers only; actions take the table as an argument.

env.name: MYSQL_ORDERING_COLUMN
env.description: For "new rows": a column that only grows, such as an AUTO_INCREMENT id or created_at.
env.builderHint: The cursor is this column's last seen value; an updated_at that moves backwards will miss rows.

env.name: MYSQL_KEY_COLUMN
env.description: The primary key column. Defaults to the ordering column for "new rows"; required for "updated rows".

env.name: MYSQL_UPDATED_AT_COLUMN
env.description: For "updated rows": a DATETIME or TIMESTAMP column, ideally ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP.

env.name: MYSQL_WHERE
env.description: Optional SQL placed after WHERE to narrow the rows a trigger watches, e.g. status = 'open'. No placeholders.

env.name: MYSQL_START_FROM
env.description: Value of the ordering column to start after ("new rows") or of updated_at to start at ("updated rows"). Blank means the newest page.

env.name: MYSQL_TITLE_COLUMN
env.description: Column to use as the item title. Blank uses the table and key.

env.name: MYSQL_LIMIT
env.description: Default 100, at most 1000.

triggers.label: Updated rows in a table
triggers.description: Fires once per change to a row, tracked by its updated_at column and primary key.

actions.label: Run a query
actions.description: Run one SQL statement with positional parameters; returns rows for a read and the counts for a write.

inputs.label: SQL
inputs.description: One SQL statement, with ? placeholders.
inputs.builderHint: Values go in params; never interpolate them into the text.

inputs.label: Parameters
inputs.description: Positional values for the placeholders, a JSON array.

outputs.description: The rows of a read, empty for a write
Rows returned, or rows a write touched
Rows a write touched, 0 for a read
The AUTO_INCREMENT value of an insert, else 0
How many warnings the server raised

actions.label: Select rows
actions.description: Read rows from a table, with an optional parameterised WHERE.

inputs.label: Table
inputs.description: table or db.table

inputs.label: Columns
inputs.description: JSON array of column names; all columns when omitted.

inputs.label: Where
inputs.description: SQL placed after WHERE, with ? placeholders, e.g. status = ?

inputs.label: Parameters
inputs.description: Values for the placeholders, a JSON array.

inputs.label: Order by
inputs.description: Column name to order by.

inputs.label: Descending
inputs.description: Order descending; default ascending.

inputs.label: Limit
inputs.description: Default 100, at most 1000.

actions.label: Insert a row
actions.description: Insert one row and return its AUTO_INCREMENT id.

inputs.label: Table
inputs.description: table or db.table

inputs.label: Values
inputs.description: JSON object of column: value, non-empty.
inputs.builderHint: An object or array value is sent as JSON text, so a JSON column takes any JSON.

actions.label: Update rows
actions.description: Set columns on the rows a WHERE matches and return how many matched.

inputs.label: Table
inputs.description: table or db.table

inputs.label: Values
inputs.description: JSON object of column: new value, non-empty.

inputs.label: Where
inputs.description: SQL placed after WHERE, with ? placeholders. Required, so a step cannot update every row by omission.

inputs.label: Parameters
inputs.description: Values for the where placeholders, a JSON array; bound after the SET values.

outputs.description: The server's Rows matched / Changed / Warnings text

actions.label: Delete rows
actions.description: Delete the rows a WHERE matches and return how many went.

inputs.label: Table
inputs.description: table or db.table

inputs.label: Where
inputs.description: SQL placed after WHERE, with ? placeholders. Required, so a step cannot delete every row by omission.

inputs.label: Parameters
inputs.description: Values for the placeholders, a JSON array.

actions.label: List tables
actions.description: List the tables and views in a database that the user can see.

inputs.label: Database
inputs.description: Defaults to the database in the connection URL.

outputs.description: Array of { name, type, engine, rows }

actions.label: Describe a table
actions.description: List the columns of a table with their types, nullability, keys and defaults.

inputs.label: Table
inputs.description: table (the URL's database) or db.table

outputs.description: Array of { name, type, dataType, nullable, key, default, extra, position }

actions.label: Count rows
actions.description: Count the rows in a table, optionally those a WHERE matches.

inputs.label: Table
inputs.description: table or db.table

inputs.label: Where
inputs.description: SQL placed after WHERE, with ? placeholders, e.g. status = ?

inputs.label: Parameters
inputs.description: Values for the placeholders, a JSON array.
